title: Technology Platform Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Technology Platform Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Creates production and non\-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.
  

**Must have skills :** Go Programming Language  

**Good to have skills :** AWS Administration  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary  

  

As a Go Developer, a typical day involves designing, developing, and supporting scalable backend applications for OTT and digital media platforms. The role focuses on API development, AWS cloud integration, performance optimization, and production support using Go and cloud\-native technologies. The candidate will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions while following Agile and DevOps practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

  

Perform independently as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Go application development.  

Design, develop, and enhance backend services using the Go programming language.  

Build and consume RESTful and gRPC APIs supporting catalog management, metadata, entitlement, playback authorization, and device registration.  

Integrate applications with AWS services including AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, AWS Fargate, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon Kinesis, and Amazon API Gateway.  

Develop efficient Go code using interfaces, structures, goroutines, channels, context propagation, and structured error handling.  

Define API contracts, data models, concurrency models, caching strategies, and resiliency patterns.  

Lead feature delivery from design through deployment and production stabilization.  

Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression test suites.  

Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and release activities.  

Analyze production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and resolve performance issues.  

Support deployment validation, rollback procedures, and operational readiness activities.  

Provide effort estimates, technical guidance, and risk assessments.  

Mentor developers and collaborate with architects, product teams, and stakeholders.  

Participate in on\-call and production support activities.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills  

  

Must\-Have Skills  

  

Strong experience in Go programming and AWS cloud development.  

Experience building RESTful and GRPC APIs.  

Strong knowledge of Go interfaces, structures, slices, maps, goroutines, channels, context propagation, error handling, and Go modules.  

Experience with Go frameworks and routers such as Gin, Echo, Chi, or net/http.  

Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures.  

Hands\-on experience with AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, AWS Fargate, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).  

Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.  

Experience with Go testing table\-driven tests, mocking, benchmarking, profiling, and race detection.  

Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Infrastructure as Code.  

Experience implementing Blue\-Green and Canary deployment strategies.  

Ability to troubleshoot distributed applications using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.  

Experience leading production incident management and technical reviews.  

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

  

Good\-To\-Have Skills  

  

Experience in OTT, Streaming, Broadcast, or Digital Media platforms.  

Knowledge of HLS, DASH, DRM technologies including Wide vine, PlayReady, and Fair Play.  

Understanding of Content Delivery Networks (CDN), Server\-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI), and Video\-on\-Demand platforms.  

Experience with AWS Elemental services including Media Live, Media Package, Media Connect, Media Convert, and Media Tailor.  

Experience with Amazon CloudFront.  

Experience with Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, and AWS Step Functions.  

Experience with Terraform, AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK), or AWS CloudFormation.  

Knowledge of Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Redis, and Amazon Elasti Cache.  

Experience with Grafana, Datadog, Elastic Stack, Splunk, and Open Telemetry.  

AWS Developer Associate or AWS Solutions Architect certification.  

Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, and IT Service Management processes.  

Experience supporting managed services and SLA\-driven environments.  

  

Additional Information  

  

Minimum 9 years of relevant experience in Go and AWS cloud development.  

Total experience requirement: 18 years (9\+9 model).  

Go Programming Language and AWS Cloud are the mandatory primary skills.  

Experience in Agile, DevOps, and cloud\-native environments is preferred.  

Participation in production support and on\-call activities may be required.  

Minimum 15 years of full\-time education required.


  

15 years full time education

title: Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)
description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer\-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce\-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit\-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Work spans both orgs: cross\-org integration, shared partner data, one\-way data hand\-offs alongside the managed package.

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS

Experience Cloud — partner portals: has implemented at least one Experience Cloud partner portal end to end — site build (LWR or Aura), self\-registration and onboarding flow, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing. Candidates who have shipped a partner portal go to the top of the list

Lending domain: Salesforce in financial services or consumer lending — origination lifecycle, borrower and partner (dealer / installer) journeys

Loan\-origination package: hands\-on with a Salesforce\-native loan/lease origination managed package. Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix experience strongly preferred

Delivery leadership: has led a delivery team of engineers on at least one client\-facing Salesforce implementation — owned the solution design, ran code review and releases, and was accountable to the client for the outcome; has owned the integration on at least one ERP\-connected implementation

Salesforce core: Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL, asynchronous Apex, Platform Events; Named Credentials; Salesforce CDC, Bulk and Streaming APIs; hands\-on on the hardest stories

APIs and integrations: REST, GraphQL and SOAP; API design — contracts, versioning, auth, error semantics; an integration platform of the Workato / MuleSoft / Boomi class; AWS Lambda, API Gateway and SQS

NetSuite integration (hands\-on): SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP) or RESTlets; quote\-to\-cash and order\-to\-cash object flows between Salesforce and NetSuite

Snowflake and data reconciliation (hands\-on): Salesforce CDC or batch extraction into Snowflake; reconciling platform data against ERP and finance

Delivery tooling: SFDX, Git, GitHub Actions CI/CD, PMD; release checklists; Jira and Confluence

Communication: camera\-on meetings, direct stakeholder communication in clear English; written status a client can act on; raises risks early, never late; works the US business calendar and US federal holidays

Experience: 8\+ years on the Salesforce platform, including tech\-lead experience running a delivery team and hands\-on delivery on at least one lending or portal\-heavy implementation

NICE TO HAVE

Portal login federated to an external identity provider (OIDC / SAML single sign\-on for Experience Cloud users); multi\-org or org\-consolidation experience

Sales, Service and Financial Services Cloud breadth; Einstein and Agentforce; AI\-assisted engineering workflows on masked or synthetic data only

Event\-driven architecture — Kafka or Azure Event Hubs; AWS S3 and Step Functions

Solar\-financing, renewable\-energy or fintech domain; prior work with US enterprise clients from offshore

CERTIFICATIONS

Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I

Preferred: Platform Developer II and Integration Architect; Experience Cloud Site Consultant; Application Architect a plus

Pay: ₹24,683\.02 \- ₹108,778\.66 per month

Work Location: On the road

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in SQL Server (T\-SQL, stored procedures, query tuning, indexing strategies) combined with hands\-on experience in PySpark, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Workflows — and is comfortable bridging the gap between on\-premise SQL environments and cloud\-based data platforms.

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and operational tasks using PowerShell scripts
* Monitor and tune Databricks cluster performance, job scheduling, and cost optimization
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data products
* Enforce data quality, governance, and lineage best practices across the platform

* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS / GCP)
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices
* Strong understanding of data warehouse and data lakehouse concepts
* Apache Iceberg\- Experience managing Iceberg table format — schema evolution, partitioning, compaction, time\-travel
* Databricks\- Hands\-on with Databricks Workflows, Unity Catalog, Delta/Iceberg integration, cluster management
* Python \- Proficient in writing clean, production\-grade Python for data engineering tasks
* PySpark \- Strong experience with distributed data processing, DataFrame API, optimizations
* SQL \- Advanced SQL — window functions, CTEs, query optimization, schema design
* PowerShell \- Scripting for automation, CI/CD pipelines, Windows/Azure environment management

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience with Azure Data Factory, dbt, or Airflow for orchestration
* Knowledge of SSIS and PowerBI/Tableau

title: IS Technology Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


ERP Manager, Operations Solutions \& Deli **Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)**  

  

There are no technical leads on this team. Everyone is a member of the technical team, and everyone stays hands\-on — senior people included. If you are looking for a title that gets you out of the code, this is not that job.

  

You will build across SAP ECC and S/4HANA, EWM, and TM, for around 4,000 business users. Extensions, integrations, data and interface work, performance. A lot of it has not been built yet.  

  

The work model for the role is: **Hybrid**

 **Reports To:** ERP Manager, Operations Solutions \& Delivery  

  

This role is contributing to the **ABB Installation Products Division** in Electrification Business Area  

.  

You will be mainly accountable for:

* **Building.** Hands\-on development every week — objects, extensions, integrations through OData and REST, and the work to keep them stable afterward.
* **Talking to the business directly.** No ticket queue between you and the person who has the problem. You sit with them, work out what they actually need, and build that — rather than building what a relayed specification said.
* **Using AI openly on the work,** and being accountable for the result. See below.
* **Shipping in small pieces, quickly.** Something small delivered this week beats something complete next quarter.
* **Keeping the quality bar.** Code review, technical documentation, design documents, recovery plans. Owned by the people who build, not enforced by someone else.
* **Security, privacy and governance compliance** on everything you touch.
* **Bringing other developers along** without stepping out of the code yourself.

 **How we work**

* **AI is expected, not tolerated.** The SAP world is conservative about this and we are not. Use assistants for development, debugging, test data, analysis and documentation — openly, and as much as they help.
* Two conditions. You own what you ship: *the model wrote it* is not a defence in code review, and we will ask you to explain generated code line by line. And throughput expectations reflect the fact that you have these tools.
* **Speed over completeness.** We would rather put something small in front of a user this week and learn from it than hand over something finished next quarter that turns out to solve the wrong problem.
* **Small team, high ownership.** Everyone builds and everyone supports. You will not be handed a narrow lane and left in it.
* **Honesty over polish.** Saying "I don't know, here is how I would find out" is a good answer here. Overstating what you have done is not.

 **Where this goes**

* The people who do well on this team end up understanding the business process better than whoever wrote the specification — and then they stop needing the specification.
* If you want to become techno\-functional rather than a career developer, say so in your application. We will put you in requirement sessions, give you process ownership as you earn it, and back you into that transition. We would rather grow you into it than watch you leave to do it somewhere else.

 **Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)**

  

* 10\+ years hands\-on with SAP, with real depth in at least one area — ABAP, Basis, FI/CO, MM, SD or comparable.
* 3\+ years on S/4HANA, including at least one full implementation.
* Strong grasp of SAP architecture, system landscape and integration technologies.
* Demonstrated configuration and customization work, not only specification writing.
* Experience with modern integration — OData, REST APIs, SAP cloud solutions.
* Able to sit with a business user and be understood. This is a customer\-facing development role.
* **Valued, not required**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or a related field.
* Breadth across ERP, EWM, TM or analytics.
* AI experience outside of SAP world
* SAP certifications in ABAP, technical or integration areas.
* Cloud platform knowledge — AWS, Azure or GCP — and hybrid architectures.
* Agile and DevOps practice in SAP environments.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or finance process background.
* RPA experience and its integration with SAP.

 **More about us (Mandatory)**


ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty\-Rap® cable ties, T\&B Liquid tight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium\-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac distribution connectors, Hi\-Tech Valiant full\-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made\-to\-stock and custom\-made solutions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Advanced Software Engineer** with 6\-10 years of software application development experience to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance enterprise IIOT applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise across frontend, backend, gateway integrations, cloud technologies, databases, and event\-driven architectures.


The candidate will work in an Agile environment and actively participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, and technical solution design while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience in software application design and development.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
* Experience building scalable distributed systems and microservices.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with IoT platforms and connected device ecosystems.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Experience with system monitoring, observability, and logging frameworks.
* Exposure to security best practices for distributed applications.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and in collaborative Agile teams.
* Strong ownership mindset and commitment to delivering quality solutions.

**Success Criteria**

* Deliver high\-quality, scalable software solutions within sprint timelines.
* Contribute to architectural, design decisions and technical discussions/decisions.
* Ensure application reliability, security, and performance.

Drive engineering excellence through best practices, automation, and code quality standards.


  
**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Design \& Development**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable enterprise\-grade software applications.
* Build responsive and interactive web applications using modern frontend frameworks.
* Develop robust backend services, APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Implement real\-time communication and streaming solutions using WebSockets and messaging platforms.
* Create secure and high\-performing gateway services for device and application integrations.

**Architecture \& Integration**

* Design and implement event\-driven architectures leveraging Kafka.
* Develop MQTT\-based communication layers for IoT and distributed systems.
* Implement RESTful APIs and service integrations using HTTP/HTTPS protocols.
* Work with Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) for efficient data serialization and inter\-service communication.

**Cloud \& DevOps**

* Design and deploy cloud\-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Monitor application health, performance, and scalability in cloud environments.

**Database \& Performance**

* Design and optimize database schemas and queries.
* Work with relational and time\-series databases.
* Implement caching strategies using Redis.
* Ensure high availability and performance of data services.

**Agile Delivery**

* Participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
* Provide accurate estimations and technical guidance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering best practices.

Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical leadership activities.


**Required Technical Skills**

**Gateway Technologies**

* Strong experience in:
	+ C\#
	+ .NET Framework / .NET Core
	+ MQTT
	+ Protocol Buffers (Protobuf)

**Frontend Development**

* React.js
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* TypeScript
* WebSocket
* REST APIs / HTTP
* State management libraries and modern frontend development practices

**Backend Development**

* Java
* Spring Framework
* Spring MVC
* Spring REST Services
* Apache Maven
* Embedded Tomcat
* Kafka
* WebSocket
* Protocol Buffers (Protobuf)
* Microservices Architecture

**Database Technologies**

* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* InfluxDB
* Database performance tuning and optimization

**Cloud Technologies**

* Microsoft Azure
* Azure App Services
* Azure Storage
* Azure Monitoring \& Diagnostics
* Azure\-based application deployment and management

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior HCL Commerce
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


Our team is looking for a **Senior HCL Commerce** **professional** who has strong knowledge of commerce platform development and modern web technologies, and who can support B2B business needs while delivering applications successfully in an Agile environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop application components, including WCS storefront and business logic, Java/Spring Boot services, and Next.js / React storefront work as assigned
* Participate in gathering requirements, documenting, and designing HCL Commerce / WCS functionality and related enhancements
* Support application integration testing, integration development, data conversion, and cut\-over activities
* Design, develop, and implement multi\-tier commerce applications to support B2B business requirements, including punchout and other customer purchasing\-system channels
* Create and review designs that identify reusability, performance issues, and best practices for Commerce, REST/SOAP services, and Java
* Support the full life cycle of storefront pages, store data, store business logic, customization of WebSphere / HCL Commerce tools, and integration with back\-end systems
* Implement Java\-based solutions for public\-facing B2B websites based on business requirements, and extend or consume Spring Boot APIs that wrap or replace Commerce capabilities
* Contribute to Next.js / React storefront work, including pages and data fetching, to keep migrated and unmigrated journeys consistent
* Perform unit testing before moving code/configuration to QA, and research defects to identify root causes across WCS, Spring Boot, and Next.js
* Identify key barriers and core problems, and apply problem\-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve issues in a dual\-run architecture

**Requirements**

* 5\-10 years of overall IT experience is required
* 5\+ years of expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x is needed, covering store customization, business logic, tools, catalog/order/user flows, and integration with back\-end systems
* 5\+ years of Java development and OOD skills on large IT systems are required, with J2EE on WebSphere Application Server strongly preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in Spring, Spring MVC, and hands\-on Spring Boot, including REST APIs and service integration, is needed
* 5\+ years of experience in web services, including REST and SOAP, is required
* 5\+ years of experience in source control is required, with Git mandatory and SVN/CVS acceptable as prior experience
* 3\+ years of experience in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is required, along with mandatory experience in Next.js and React; TypeScript is preferred
* Experience with Agile delivery using Atlassian tools, including Jira, Bitbucket/Git, and Confluence, is expected
* Strong communication skills and proven team player capability are essential

**Nice to have**

* Background in B2B commerce, punchout, and/or mobile commerce business models
* Familiarity with headless or composable commerce patterns, including API\-first storefronts that consume Commerce or BFF/microservices; MuleSoft or similar iPaaS experience is a plus
* Knowledge of additional JS frameworks, such as Angular or Vue, as secondary experience
* Exposure to search (Solr), session/page cache (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts such as Optimizely or equivalent alongside a commerce engine
* Understanding that Preview and Runtime Commerce stacks are distinct environments rather than identical ones

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Senior SW Engineer (JAVA)
description:
Overview:

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer  

**Experience Level**: 5\-8 years of professional experience in the applicable field.  

**Education**: Requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Job Summary:**  

The Senior Software Engineer is a fully competent professional responsible for delivering complex software solutions by applying broad and deep knowledge of engineering principles, practices, and procedures. This role involves significant technical ownership, with assignments that demand originality, ingenuity, and the ability to make independent decisions that influence the organization’s projects or clients. The Senior Software Engineer cooperates with Architects to identify reference patterns and best practices and mentors and guides junior or intermediate engineers, providing technical direction and oversight when needed.  

The candidate, being in contact with other engineering teams in Europe, India and US, will work to the creation of a microservices architecture built in Java, Spring, React deployed in a container\-based environment (Kubernetes) into a cloud infrastructure
Principal Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, test, and implement complex software systems and applications, ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Apply broad technical expertise to solve advanced problems and deliver innovative solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural planning sessions.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Associate, Junior, and Intermediate Software Engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (e.g., product managers, QA, DevOps) to define and implement requirements.
* Take ownership of projects, ensuring completion within scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend enhancements that may have significant business impact.
* Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, or frameworks to improve the development process.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for specific systems, components, or business areas.
* Provide recommendations that influence client deliverables or organizational decisions.


Position Requirements:
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s degree a plus).
* 5\-8 years of professional experience in software engineering or application development.
* Proven experience in Java programming especially with Spring framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, etc.)
* String experience with API development (REST or GraphQL) and integration projects, with focus on security and performances.
* Proficiency with ORM frameworks and relational databases best practices
* Knowledge of JavaScript frontend frameworks (especially React) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and system scalability.
* Experience in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with secure coding practices and performance optimization.
* Experience in leveraging AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) and apply prompt engineering to accelerate delivery across development, testing, and operations.
* Able to design and build integrations with LLM services and cloud AI platforms, collaborating with Architects and Product teams to embed AI capabilities and agentic workflows into products.
* Good command of English (written and spoken)

**Skills and Competencies:*** Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills with a high level of technical innovation.
* Strong ability to independently evaluate and make technical decisions with minimal supervision.
* Good communication and leadership skills for collaborating with stakeholders and guiding junior engineers.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, proposing solutions, and driving technical strategy.
* Ability to manage broad, challenging assignments with originality and ingenuity.

 **Work Environment:*** Operates as a senior\-level individual contributor with minimal lead\-level or middle management intervention.
* Provides oversight and guidance to Associates or Intermediate Engineers.
* Has appreciable latitude for independent action and decision\-making on critical tasks.
* Contributes to strategic technical recommendations that impact business outcomes.

 **What We Offer:**  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M:**  

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.  

* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit** – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* **Accountability** – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* **Metrics\-Driven Results** – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.
  

**EEO:**
  

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

People First, Last \+ Always

We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.
